id: title:cvolzer3:show auth type and url on the gateway server detail

review.posthog_relevance: Adds OAuth and API key authentication type labels to the GatewayServerScene UI, potentially helping users distinguish authentication methods alongside server URLs.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, localized frontend UI update. P1.F1.H3 replaces a server description span with a joined list including authentication type and URL, and P1.F1.H2 adds the necessary mapping. This does not demonstrate backend implementation, tests, or migration, and the score is assigned based solely on the observed UI modification.
review.uncertainty: The score relies entirely on the supplied observations; no backend implementation, tests, or release notes are present to verify the change's stability or broader impact. The benefit is conjectural, not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend UI change. No backend or API implementation, no tests, no migration, no release notes. The score cannot be assigned. No tier. No score.

observations.behavior: Adds MCPAuthTypeEnumApi to imports; P1.F1.H2 adds AUTH_TYPE_LABELS mapping; P1.F1.H3 replaces server.created_by span with a joined list including template_auth_type and server.url, removing the explicit server.created_by span. P1.F1.H3 also adds a min-w-0 truncate class.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds OAuth and API key auth type labels to the server description, alongside the server URL, in the GatewayServerScene.
